title: Your first trade for Tuesday, November 20
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Pete Najarian was a buyer of Paypal
Tim Seymour was a buyer of Coca-Cola
Dan Nathan was a seller of Coca-Cola
Guy Adami was a buyer of Valero
